changed: The dance and program editors now have Save at the end of the top bar, as every other editor does, instead of a floating button that covered the form. In the program builder on a phone, Save shows as a check mark and Perform moves into the More actions menu.

On a dance's page and a program's summary, Edit is now a pencil with the page's other actions, and a dance previewed from an online search has Import in the top bar; the floating button at the bottom of the screen is only ever for adding something new to a list.

An empty Collection, Programs list, venues list or custom fields list, and the Collection's first-run card, show their own New button without a second floating one below it; sort controls appear once there is something to sort.
The Custom Figures and Figure shorthands screens now add a new entry with a floating button at the bottom of the screen, like the other managers, once they have one.
